Action, trust-root, legal holds, every planned file digest and an initial signing preflight are checked before quarantine creation. The plan intent is written before any rename.

Each planned file is renamed; a failed rename rolls moved entries back in reverse order. Successful rollback removes only its repair intent and empty directories. A rollback failure reports the stuck paths; no evidence delete path is used.

Moved bytes are checked, then the receipt is signed in a second signer call and its signature/receipt written atomically per file. Failure after moves can leave an interrupted quarantine; archivedStores lists receipt/intent existence, not verified receipt authenticity.

Both 17-element signing-kind lists match exactly and include REPAIR_RECEIPT. Policy chooses local vault or notary. verifySignedDigest consults local auditor key history; CLI fixture coverage is not an independently pinned external issuer or trusted-time proof.
